adapter.title: T480 Ollama Readiness
adapter.summary: Compares the literal loopback Ollama inventory with the approved digest-pinned local model profile set.

use_cases: Verify the local T480 Ollama runtime before an approved local solution uses an approved model.
fit_for: Read-only local inventory and exact digest readiness checks.
not_for: Model installation, deletion, generation proxying, runtime reconfiguration, or any non-loopback endpoint.
limitations: A consumer must explicitly provide the loopback probe; a successful check proves only the current local inventory.

provenance.changed_from: No source code or configuration copied; reduced to a literal loopback, read-only inventory comparison against this repository's approved profile data.

capabilities.name: local_model_readiness
capabilities.description: Read and verify the approved local Ollama inventory.

operations.name: inspect_inventory
operations.summary: Read the literal loopback inventory and compare exact approved model digests.
operations.retry_guidance: Retry after the local Ollama service is restored or the approved profile set is refreshed.
